issues.detail: The Hebrew number is 157,600 (מְאַת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת = 100,000 + 57,000 + 600). The Chinese says 一百萬五十七萬六百人, which reads as 1,570,600 (one million, five hundred seventy thousand, six hundred), a completely different number. The correct rendering should be 十五萬七千六百人.
